# Support

## Documentation

Start with the [documentation index](../docs/README.md):

- [Quick start](../docs/quickstart/README.md) — run the stack locally
- [Features](../docs/features/README.md) — configs, resolving, secrets, auth
- [How-to guides](../docs/how-to/README.md) — common tasks
- [Reference](../docs/reference/README.md) — REST API, CLI, SDK

Interactive API docs are available at `/api/docs` when the server is running.

## Questions

Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/ocmo-oss/ocmo/discussions) for questions, ideas, and
show-and-tell when available. Otherwise, open a [feature request issue](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml).

## Bugs

Open a [bug report](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml) with steps to reproduce, version, and logs.

## Security

Do **not** open public issues for security problems. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and pull request guidelines.
